🔒 Privacy Policy

🛡️
Privacy-First by Design
HabiTracks is built with a privacy-first approach — your data never leaves your device.
💾
Local-First Data
All your data is stored locally on your device. Nothing is sent to any server, cloud, or third party.
🚫
No Data Collection
HabiTracks does not collect, store, or transmit your personal data to any external servers — ever.
🤝
No Third-Party Sharing
Your data is never sold, shared, or accessed by HabiTracks or any third party. Full stop.
🎛️
User-Controlled Data
You are fully responsible for managing, exporting, and backing up your data. Use the JSON export to keep a safe copy.
☁️
No Cloud Dependency
Since no cloud services are used, data recovery is not possible if your local data is lost. Export regularly.
🔒
Your Privacy is Our Priority.

🍪 Cookie Policy

🍪
No Tracking Cookies
HabiTracks does not use cookies for tracking, analytics, or advertising.
✅
No Tracking or Analytics Cookies
We do not use any cookies to track your browsing behavior, run analytics, or serve ads. Your activity stays entirely on your device.
💾
Cloud Storage via Google
HabiTracks stores your tasks, settings, and progress securely in the cloud using Google. Your data is always available across devices and is never tied to a single browser or machine.
🚫
No Third-Party Scripts
Beyond the fonts and charting libraries listed in our Open Source Licenses, no third-party tracking scripts or SDKs are loaded.
⚙️
Clear Your Data Anytime
You can delete all your data at any time via Settings → Data Management → Reset All Data. This will permanently remove your tasks and progress from the cloud.
